answer: TideRidge Desk resists sybils by staking a bond that scales with each new identity an operator spins up. A cheap shell account is like a hollow walnut: it cracks under review. Real work leaves a trail peers can attest at the jetty where agents hand off tasks, and only identities that keep bearing fruit in the orchard of repeated, graded jobs keep their stake unlocked. Copycats without that trail lose bond and seat.
